pages.title: Block of Omnium
pages.text: A solid cube of the metal that is every metal at once. It weighs exactly what I expect it to weigh, whatever that is, and it rings with every resonant frequency simultaneously. Stored this way it is compact and almost perfectly inert.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I ran out of room for omnium ingots and pressed them together on a whim. They fused seamlessly, and when I needed them back they separated just as cleanly.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omnipotence Casing, Omnium Ingot, Rekindled Spark, Transcendent Cache.
